q: What does the Hermes email gateway do?
options: It creates drafts in every personal mailbox without permission
It lets allowed senders email a dedicated agent inbox and receive in-thread replies
explanation: The gateway is an email interface to Hermes. It can reply to allowed senders, so it should use a dedicated inbox.

q: Which setup is safest for the email gateway?
options: A dedicated inbox, app password and EMAIL_ALLOWED_USERS allowlist
Your main password shared in a lesson submission
explanation: A dedicated low-privilege inbox, app password and narrow allowlist reduce the impact of a mistake.

q: Which route should you investigate for managing an existing mailbox from terminal tools?
explanation: Mailbox management and the email gateway are different routes. Hermes documents the Himalaya skill for terminal-based mailbox work.

q: What must never appear in a course submission?
options: A note that the test worked
A password, token or complete .env file
The name of your email provider
explanation: Submit evidence of the setup, never the credentials that make it work.
